name: html-view-sync-reminder
description: Advisory-only (never blocks) reminder printed when a commit changes Markdown inside a governed domain that has already opted into a static index.html overview (references/html-overview-views.md), but the overview wasn't touched in the same commit. Only fires for domains that already have an index.html present -- it never suggests creating one. Deliberately non-blocking: whether a given edit actually needs the HTML view refreshed is a judgment call the script cannot make.
